description: This Dart source file defines a utility class ExportUtils for exporting byte data to a user-chosen location, often used for saving documents out of an app sandbox in a Flutter application.

classes.name: ExportUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for exporting byte data to the file system with user interaction, handling optional MIME types and fallback save locations.

methods.name: exportBytes
methods.description: Exports a byte array as a file to a user-specified location, optionally including MIME type considerations and fallback saving if no path is selected.
